name: feature.kb.nodes
description: Knowledge Base feature node pack — workflow nodes over the `ctx.features.kb` surface shipped by the KB feature. `search` retrieves chunks from one collection; `rag` retrieves + builds an augmented prompt + citations for an agent/callPrompt downstream; `list-collections` discovers a collectionId. Those three are role:"action" reads (recorded → replay/fork serve the recorded result). v1.2.0 (ADR 0643 D2) adds `reindex-drain`, the ONLY role:"side-effect" node here: it drives one bounded slice of an already-started embedding-spec reindex, and its terminal branch flips the collection's serving namespace and DELETES the old one — so the derived side-effect floor is what stops a `mode:'replay'` fork re-executing it. It is NOT a general-purpose verb: the surface refuses it unless a `running`/`paused` job already exists (only the `host:org:manage` REST door can create one) AND the executing run's workflowId is the host-minted `kb.reindex:<tenantId>:<orgId>:<collectionId>` — declaring the node in an arbitrary tenant…
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: KB Search
nodes.description: Semantic search within one KB collection via ctx.features.kb.search. Inputs: { orgId, collectionId, query, topK? }. Output: { results }.

nodes.label: KB RAG (retrieve + augment)
nodes.description: Retrieve + assemble a grounded augmented prompt + citations via ctx.features.kb.rag. Inputs: { orgId, collectionId, query, topK? }. Output: { augmentedPrompt, citations, contexts } — feed augmentedPrompt to a downstream callPrompt/agent (generation is run-scoped).

nodes.label: KB List Collections
nodes.description: Lists an org's KB collections via ctx.features.kb.listCollections — discover a collectionId before search/rag. Inputs: { orgId }. Output: { collections }. Tenant-guarded.

nodes.label: KB Reindex Drain
nodes.description: Drives ONE bounded slice of an in-progress KB reindex via ctx.features.kb.reindexDrain — embed the next `maxChunks` into the staging namespace, then CUT OVER when the staging space is whole. Inputs: { orgId, collectionId, maxChunks? }. Output: { status, embeddedChunks, totalChunks, done, error? }. STRUCTURALLY scoped: the surface refuses unless a running/paused job already exists (created only by the admin-gated REST start) AND the run's workflowId is the host-minted `kb.reindex:<tenantId>:<orgId>:<collectionId>`. Never touches media extraction (replay-unsafe by design) — it re-embeds existing durable chunk text only.
